type: retrospective descriptive analysis of previously saved statistics and predictions
question: Separate recovery R and fitted cell-transfer w contributions to the decline of cell-mismatch cost with scale, and quantify the approximation remainder.
authorization: Existing data only; no training or new model inference.
primary: DIV2K 0869-0900, 32 center-240 crops, seed 1, LIIF/LTE/SC-INR; original v11 aggregate sufficient statistics
replication: Set14, 14 center-240 crops, seeds 1 and 2, same three models; saved float16 v1 predictions, no network execution
primary_scope: Original 16 fixed r bands, width 1/32, 0<r<0.5; DC and exact Nyquist outer row/column excluded
additional_scope: For saved Set14 predictions, separately audit DC and Nyquist outer ring, and include all non-DC bins as sensitivity analysis
normalization: RGB-mean spatial MSE units: original v11 sums divided once by (32 * 3 * 232^4); per-image saved statistics divided once by (3 * 232^4)

definitions.w: K/U, fitted separately for each model, scale, multiplier and frequency band

aggregation: Fit w per model after pooling images and seeds; derive quantities first, then equal-weight the three models. Cross-scale target energies must agree.
uncertainty: DIV2K has aggregate points only. Set14 uses 2000 paired image-cluster bootstrap samples, fixed seed 20261023, resampling all scales/models/seeds together and refitting w in each sample. Conditional on the two existing trained seeds; not training-population uncertainty.
limitations: This is not a new preregistered hypothesis test and does not alter frozen source results.
R and w attribution is descriptive, not causal or an out-of-sample prediction.
Q can be negative where R is negative; negative terms are retained.
MSE component shares are not dB component shares; baseline MSE changes with scale.
Saved Set14 predictions are float16 and provide a separate cohort, not image confidence intervals for DIV2K.
The training benefit of cell is not identified by this inference perturbation analysis.
